values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267 (Mon-Fri 9-5); DNR: 'Reservations are Recommended'. Check-in between 3 p.m. and 9:30 p.m.; campsite check-out 1 p.m. Pets only in the Choptank, Elk, Miles, North East, Susquehanna and Wye loops.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/elk-neck-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380108 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx ('Reservations are Recommended'; 'Check-in time is between 3 p.m. and 9:30 p.m.'; 'Check-out times are 11 a.m. for cabins and 1 p.m. for campsites'; pets line) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/elkneck.aspx, read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx ('North East Camping Loop 28 sites with electric (50, 30 and 20 amp), water and sewer hookups'; 'Chester Camping Loop 19 sites with electric hook-ups (50, 30 and 20 amp)') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/elk-neck-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380108 (per-site details: all 51 electric sites list 'Electrical Service (amp): 20, 30, 50'; the 28 North East Loop sites Water Service Y, Sewer Service Y), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: 'The park has 250 campsites' (the booking site lists 218: 167 non-electric, 23 electric, 28 full-hookup). Most RV-capable sites are back-ins of 25-30 ft, some 35-40; six North East Loop full-hookup sites are pull-throughs (20-25 ft). All of Sassafras Loop and parts of Bohemia, Choptank, Susquehanna and Wye are tent sites.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/elk-neck-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380108 (site list and per-site details: Looking For Category, Driveway Entry, Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Each camping loop has a central bathhouse with hot showers; five bathhouses are being renovated during the 2026 season. The park store is staffed on weekends Memorial Day to Labor Day; firewood ($5) and ice ($2.50) are sold by honor box, cash or check.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx ('Each camp loop has a central bathhouse with hot running water and showers'; 'The Park Store is open seasonally. Firewood and ice are sold outside of the Park Store via an honor box system') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/elkneck.aspx ('renovation of five bathhouses within the campground') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/elk-neck-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380108 (Services and Amenities: 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Elk Neck and Elk River Camping Area pages and the MD booking site: reservable 365 days ahead and same-day; 50-amp electric, water and sewer (North East Loop full hookups, Chester electric); 250 campsites (218 on the booking site) to 40 ft with some pull-throughs; bathhouses with hot showers, dump, seasonal store. Season (manual) matches the 2026 loop closures. Fees left (manual) but see the non-resident flag. Weekend/holiday minimums: DNR states them only for the cabins (left inherited for campsites). Phone 410-287-5333 matches. Note kept.
flags: Fees conflict (manual, not overwritten): the entry's fees.note says 'no out-of-state camping surcharge', but DNR's Elk River Camping Area page says '*In addition to this base price, non-Maryland residents will be charged an additional $1 fee per night. Weekend and Holiday nights will also cost an additional $1 fee per night. A one-time $6.25 transaction fee is charged per stay.' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx). Its base prices match the entry ($21.50 standard, $27.50 Chester electric, $36.50 North East full hookup). Consider fees.nonresident {surcharge $1 per night}; the same $1 non-resident line may apply statewide.
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/ElkNeck/River-Camping-Area.aspx.
